# HowToEdibles

> Cannabis edibles recipe site with a dosage calculator. 237 recipes across 8 categories, each with mg of THC per serving, plus 50 guides on dosing, safety and the science of edibles. Online since 2017.

## About

HowToEdibles helps adults prepare cannabis-infused food at home with a dose they can predict. Every recipe page includes a dosage calculator that computes mg of THC per serving from the amount of cannabis, its potency percentage and the number of portions.

The core formula: dosage_mg = (10 × grams × strength_percent × 0.8) / num_portions, where 0.8 is the cooking efficiency (about 20% of THC is lost during decarboxylation and infusion). Recipe defaults are set to at most 15 mg THC per serving.

How the content is written and checked, and how the site is funded: https://www.howtoedibles.com/about.html

## Key Pages

- [Edible Dosage Calculator](https://www.howtoedibles.com/edible-dosage-calculator/): THC mg per serving for any recipe
- [All Recipes](https://www.howtoedibles.com/): 237 cannabis edible recipes, grouped by category
- [All Guides](https://www.howtoedibles.com/articles.html): the 50 articles
- [Cannabutter](https://www.howtoedibles.com/recipes/cannabutter/): the base most recipes use
- [Cannabis Tincture](https://www.howtoedibles.com/recipes/cannabis-tincture/): alcohol extract for sublingual dosing or drinks
- [Science of Decarboxylation](https://www.howtoedibles.com/science-of-decarboxylation.html): why and how to activate THC before cooking
- [How Long Do Edibles Take to Kick In](https://www.howtoedibles.com/how-long-do-edibles-take-to-kick-in.html): onset times, duration and the factors behind them
- [Cannabis Edibles for Beginners](https://www.howtoedibles.com/cannabis-edibles-for-beginners.html): start low, go slow
- [Microdosing Edibles](https://www.howtoedibles.com/microdosing-edibles.html): low-dose use
- [CBD vs THC](https://www.howtoedibles.com/cbd-vs-thc.html): differences between the two cannabinoids
- [How to Prevent a Bad Trip](https://www.howtoedibles.com/how-to-prevent-a-bad-trip.html): safety and harm reduction

## Recipe Categories

- [Desserts](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/desserts/): brownies, cookies, cakes, chocolate truffles, ice cream
- [Drinks](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/drinks/): smoothies, hot chocolate, tea, lemonade, coffee
- [Snacks](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/snacks/): gummies, granola bars, popcorn, firecrackers
- [Essentials](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/essentials/): cannabutter, cannabis oil, tinctures, sugar
- [Lunch](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/lunch/): soups, salads, sandwiches, pasta, pizza
- [Keto](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/keto/): low-carb fat bombs, keto brownies, cheese crisps
- [Vegan](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/vegan/): plant-based edibles without dairy or animal products
- [International](https://www.howtoedibles.com/category/international/): feijoada, brigadeiro, churros, baklava, mochi

Recipe URLs follow https://www.howtoedibles.com/recipes/{slug}/.

## Safety Information

- Recommended starting dose: 2.5–5 mg THC for beginners
- Standard dose: 10 mg THC per serving
- Onset time: 30–90 minutes (can take up to 2 hours); wait at least 2 hours before taking more
- Duration: 4–8 hours
- Always label cannabis edibles clearly and store them away from children and pets
